Regression: initial 4127 points load, detail modal displays name/coords/hours/carriers/address. pt-00001 verified clean after tests (no leftover override).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:257 admin_update_point() only writes 'name' to Mongo when data.name.strip() is truthy. This means an admin cannot clear/restore a name via PUT — they must call DELETE. Fine as documented behaviour, but worth noting.

PointDetail.js:41-43 initial useState(point.name/lat/lng) is set only on mount. If the parent updates the same 'selected' point (e.g., via onUpdated) without unmounting the modal, edit-name-input still shows the previously typed value until the modal is reopened. Not blocking (save closes editing), but re-opening edit on the same session after a name change works because setName(data.name) runs inside resetEdit. Save keeps the state in sync via new_name.
server.py admin routes do not persist author/timestamp of the override. Consider storing updated_by, updated_at in point_overrides for audit trail.

server.py validation ranges (41.0–51.5 lat / -5.8–9.8 lng) exclude Corsica edges partially (Corsica lat ~41.3–43.0 lng 8.5–9.6 which is fine) — bounds are OK for mainland+Corsica, but not overseas territories (DOM-TOM). Acceptable given app scope is France métropolitaine.

Regression from previous iterations still relevant: MapApp.js ~695 lines with duplicated aside/mobile-sheet UI blocks (consider extraction), liveMode not URL-persisted. No new files added — feature was cleanly implemented in existing components.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin edit feature works end-to-end. Backend endpoints: PUT /api/admin/points/{id} body {name?, lat?, lng?} → 200 + updated point (edited:true); DELETE /api/admin/points/{id} → 200 + original point. Auth via httpOnly cookie (samesite=none, secure) OR Bearer header. 401 unauth, 403 non-admin, 404 unknown id, 400 out-of-France coords. Overrides persisted in db.point_overrides and cached in _OVERRIDES dict (loaded at startup). Frontend testids: detail-edit-btn (only when isAdmin=user.role==='admin'), admin-edit-panel, edit-name-input, edit-lat-input, edit-lng-input, edit-save-btn, edit-reset-btn. onUpdated callback in MapApp.js updates both selected and points list so map + list stay in sync. pt-00001 is the safe test target — always clean up after tests.
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs found. Implementation matches spec across backend and frontend.
